name: SubmitHunt

sources.title: SubmitHunt homepage — rendered nearly empty (JS-only) with two sponsor links
AllDirectories field report — login required, two-step submit form, free plan queued
Smol Launch directory list — SubmitHunt listed as Free + Dofollow
LaunchDirectories profile — SubmitHunt free submissions, dofollow

requirements: Account/login required — the submit form is only reachable while signed in
Two-step form: (1) basic product info — name, URL, slug, description, category, X username; (2) launch plan selection + launch date picker
No logo/screenshot upload and no long-description or tags fields in the form per the third-party field report
preparation: Product name, URL, preferred slug, description, category, X/Twitter username
workflow: Sign up / log in on submithunt.com
Step 1: enter name, URL, slug, description, category, X username
Step 2: pick the launch plan (Free) and a launch date
Submit — confirmation reads 'Startup Submitted Successfully! ... added to the queue and will be featured soon'
watchFor: The homepage renders almost nothing to non-JS fetches — only sponsor links; the app is client-rendered, so verify pages in a real browser

Third-party sources conflict on cost: Smol Launch and LaunchDirectories list it as Free + Dofollow, while SaaSCity's directory list marks it 'Paid' and AllDirectories calls it a 'paid directory' with a described free plan — treat pricing as unstable
Choosing a non-free launch plan in step 2 may add charges — confirm the selected plan before submitting
countsAsLive: The product is featured on the SubmitHunt home page / launch listing after its queued launch date.
unknowns: Whether a real free tier still exists (directory aggregators disagree)
Launch queue length and review process
Whether outbound links are dofollow on the free plan
